text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's pretty lively here today, even though there aren't any graded races.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... is everyone here to see
Mejiro Ramonu's Debut race?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do!
I'm aiming for the Triple Tiara before my debut even starts!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"If she were just an ordinary girl, folks would just say, 'She's sure confident,'
but coming from the prestigious Mejiro family...
This is gonna be quite a show."
choice_data_list: (Now this, this really feels like a Make Debut!)

text_block_list.text:
Before a debut race, a unique atmosphere fills the venue.
Packed with insiders and hardcore fans, an air of scrutiny
mixes with the tension of running for the first time.
choice_data_list: (As their Trainer, I need to look after them.)

text_block_list.text: However, Mejiro Ramonu herself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (Doesn't look nervous at all, does she?)

text_block_list.text:
I really couldn't imagine her trembling at her debut race.
...Or so I had thought—
"Could it be that... she's actually really nervous, and just putting up a brave front—?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I can't take this...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, my heart's pounding...!
I might be done for...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'll do just as Trainer says.
...If I do that, I can win, I will win...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Everyoooone...!
Do your beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I truly am beautiful, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's our first date, after all.
It's only natural to feel a little anxious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because,
it is my first time touching one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to trace it,
this skin that I love so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I've already decided on my first step.
I'll step forward gently... ever so gently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"And then, take a deep breath.
To preserve this moment that will never come again."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh, I must not rush.
I have to cherish it... take good care of it..."

"Now I understand. Mejiro Ramonu was trembling
with the sheer joy of truly loving racing
from here on out."

As expected, Mejiro Ramonu remains "unfathomable."
Perhaps, no matter how much we talk...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's almost time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everything I have honed for "you"...
I shall give it all to you.
